paragraphs.text: Which serve for vain ostentation and for no true comfort.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: I would that you felt what I do.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: soul were in my soul's stead

paragraphs.text: That is, mock at your misery, as you do at mine.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: If this were in my power, yet I would comfort you and not do as you do to me.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: If you would say, "Why do you not then comfort yourself?" he answers that the judgments of God are more heavy than he is able to assuage either by words or silence.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Meaning, God.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: That is, destroyed most of my family.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: In token of sorrow and grief.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: That is, God by his wrath: and in this diversity of words and high style, he expresses how grievous the hand of God was on him.
paragraphs.label: k
paragraphs.anchor: He teareth me in his wrath

paragraphs.text: That is, has handled me contemptuously: for so slapping the cheek signified, 1Ki 22:24, Mr 14:65
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: They have led me where they would.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: His manifold afflictions.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: I am wounded to the heart.
paragraphs.label: o

paragraphs.text: Meaning, his glory was brought low.
paragraphs.label: p

paragraphs.text: Signifying that he is not able to understand the cause of this his grievous punishment.
paragraphs.label: q

paragraphs.text: That is, unfeigned and without hypocrisy.
paragraphs.label: r

paragraphs.text: Let my sin be known if I am such a sinner as my adversaries accuse me, and let me find no favour.
paragraphs.label: s

paragraphs.text: Though man condemn me, yet God is witness of my cause.
paragraphs.label: t

paragraphs.text: Use painted words instead of true consolation.
paragraphs.label: u

paragraphs.text: Thus by his great torments he is carried away, and breaks out into passions, and speaks unadvisedly, as though God would intreat man more gently, seeing he has only a short time here to live.
paragraphs.label: x
